lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
FAA lifts nationwide ground stop that disrupted thousands of flights, CBS News reports.
Zelenskyy says a new European security framework floated by US could benefit Putin, The Associated Press reports.
Five people, including three children, are in hospital fighting for their lives after a residential fire broke out early this morning in Burlington, The Canadian Press reports.

U.S. negotiators have floated the idea of Ukraine’s potential withdrawal from its eastern region of Donbas in exchange for joining NATO, President Volodymyr Zelenskiysaid, following the latest round of peace talks with Russia in Abu Dhabi, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
